comment: makemon.c makemon(): forcing Dispater at #wizgenesis's "force Dispater?" prompt puts him on a square the hero remembers as an unseen monster (I). The byyou newsym() at makemon.c:1392 runs while he is still visible and overwrites the I; then the MS_BRIBE demon prince turns invisible, and the closing newsym() shows the floor. C erases the I; a port that sets the invisibility first keeps it.
